question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` plus `defaultAccount`, with root-level legacy config as the implicit default account and a distinct listener port required for each named bot?
rationale: This is a durable public configuration, listener, credential, routing, and state contract; correctness and live proof cannot determine whether maintainers want to support that boundary long term.

options.title: Accept proposed contract
options.body: Adopt the standard account model, preserve legacy default behavior, and document distinct listener ports for named bots.

options.title: Require shared-listener design
options.body: Pause until multiple bot identities can multiplex separate webhook paths through one listener port.

options.title: Decline multi-account support
options.body: Keep one Teams bot identity per gateway despite the proven implementation and canonical feature demand.

recommendation.title: Accept proposed contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the standard account model, preserve legacy default behavior, and document distinct listener ports for named bots.
